text: There’s a parking ticket under the napkins in the glove box you didn’t notice when you grabbed your sunglasses out of there last Tuesday. It’s from back in April, and if you don’t take care of it soon, it’ll double. I’m keeping an eye out for it. I’m keeping an eye out for you. I’m keeping an eye out for anyone that ever told you that they’d take care of you and then didn’t. The Protector’s job is as big as leaving someone who isn’t safe for you and as small as a parking ticket in the glove box.
